title: Ideation session
prompt: [MEETING] Ideation session — company week 2, day 3 (2026-08-02). Run an ideation session: read BOARD_BRIEF.md, VISION.md and the current src/, then convene the designer and architect (agent tools) around the question 'what would make this product noticeably better for its users?'. Bring at least 3 concrete ideas, argue them against the brief, keep the best one or two and file them with create_github_issue including the value case. Save the minutes.
